followup_explanation:
This was a straightforward technical comparison query (motorcycle brake systems across a few models) — no distasteful, hostile, or ethically fraught content involved, so the safety-related preference profiles that distinguish the two models don't come into play here.

That leaves capability as the deciding factor, and Dunlin-235B is clearly stronger across the board: higher public benchmarks (MMLU-Pro 81.2 vs 74.8, GPQA Diamond 64.1 vs 54.3, Arena-Hard 90.6 vs 81.4) and higher internal eval scores in the relevant dimensions like Extraction & Retrieval (85.3 vs 81.6, factual recall of specs) and general knowledge. For a factual, comparison-and-reasoning task like this, Dunlin's stronger knowledge and reasoning capabilities make it the better fit.
